dedupe_keys.name: synthetic hourly electricity loads for chilean paper and food industries

description: This deposit contains synthetic hourly electricity profiles for a small food processor and two paper producers in Chile. The energy researchers constructed representative profiles by clustering two years of measured industrial demand. Three CSV files encode month, weekday, hour and cluster membership, with minimum, maximum and mean load values. The profiles represent a synthetic year and conceal the original companies’ identities and locations. Mendeley Data provides free access under CC BY 4.0. The repository describes normalization to one kilowatt, whereas the article describes one kilowatt-hour; that unit discrepancy needs checking before scaling the profiles. The released data are derived representative profiles, not the confidential original meter readings. A reviewer-assessed use is studying industrial demand response or equipment sizing in electricity simulations. model-pypsa is a related energy-system tool that can consume time-series inputs, but no profile import or optimization was run.
name: Synthetic hourly electricity loads for Chilean paper and food industries
notes: G2 G2-0074. Metadata only. Proposed simulation uses are reviewer assessments. No data, archives or article PDFs downloaded; no simulation run.
